focus: KAIMAN/KERAKAM WT1.1 sheets 1-21, physical PDF pages 41-61

coverage.sheets_1_21: key printed dimensions + semantic endpoints bound; nonexhaustive

critical_findings: WT1.1 standard wall geometry is now explicitly machine-bound as 120 mm facing brick + 10 mm gap + 380 mm ceramic core + 15 mm interior plaster = 525 mm total where printed on the source sheets.
Prefabricated slab-edge, monolithic slab-edge, window-head, internal-wall intersection, plinth and wood-beam families now have source-printed dimensions bound to semantic endpoints.
Opening sheets bind the printed 3000 mm storey height, 1630 mm window height and 910 mm sill height only as geometry of this manufacturer detail family, not universal project defaults.
Wood-beam detail binds the printed 120x200 mm beam section, 250 mm bearing length, 40 mm side clearances and 20 mm vertical clearances; structural adequacy remains project-calculation input.
Corner sheets 6-7 now preserve the source row/course bond schedule instead of treating the corner as generic masonry.
No value was obtained from pixel/raster measurement. Ambiguous printed dimensions are marked semantics_partial and do not unlock commit.
